snippet.title: ZERO PARADES: Director's Cut - Console Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
ZERO PARADES: Director’s Cut is Out Now on 
PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and Nintendo Switch 2!

ZERO PARADES makes its console debut with the Director’s Cut from day one, including approximately 40,000 words of new material, Backstage Mode, completed English voice-over and the full slate of improvements introduced since the original PC release.

Plus, get a -10% celebratory launch discount.

Playstation 5 https://www.playstation.com/en-sa/games/zero-parades-for-dead-spies/
Xbox https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/zero-parades-directors-cut/9n2tdpglp9jz
Nintendo Switch 2 https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/zero-parades-directors-cut-switch-2/
